title: Mara and the Protocol
author: Cyrus Underhill
blurb: Juniper Thornbury, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
